message: You know, I’ve always said it’s better to be prepared than to be caught off guard. With storm season upon us, I found a handy little resource that lays out what to do when those wild winds start howling. It’s like having a cozy blanket of knowledge wrapped around you when the skies get a bit too dramatic. Just remember, a little planning can go a long way in keeping things calm—who knew that being ready could feel so smart? 🌩️
